import subprocess,numpy as np,h5py,gmsh,json,tempfile
gmsh.initialize();gmsh.finalize()
p={'operation':0,'wavenumber_real':1.1,'wavenumber_imag':0.,'sources':[[i*.01,0.,0.] for i in range(32)],'targets':[[2.,1.,1.]],'strength':[[.3,.2]]*32}
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='bempp-original-health-') as work:
 result=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['/opt/bempp-env/bin/python','/opt/repair-driver/driver.py'],input=json.dumps(p),text=True,cwd=work))
assert set(result)=={'fmm_potential','fmm_gradient','local_potential','local_gradient'}
for suffix,cols in [('potential',2),('gradient',6)]:
 fast=np.asarray(result['fmm_'+suffix]);local=np.asarray(result['local_'+suffix])
 assert fast.shape==local.shape==(1,cols) and np.all(np.isfinite(fast)) and np.all(np.isfinite(local))
 assert np.all(abs(fast-local)<=1e-6+1e-5*abs(local)) and np.any(abs(local)>1e-8)
print(json.dumps({'actual_original_native_point_and_gradient':'ready','sources':32,'targets':1,'real_wavenumber':1.1}))
